name: Odoo
doctor: docker compose exec odoo /entrypoint.sh odoo openreceive doctor -d shop

credential_store.where: the OpenReceive module's own settings table (odoo openreceive configure)

products: select count(*) from product_template where is_published and default_code in ('facet', 'bezel', 'hinge', 'latch', 'knob')
orderStatus: psql -U odoo -d shop -At -c "select so.state from payment_transaction t join sale_order_transaction_rel r on r.transaction_id = t.id join sale_order so on so.id = r.sale_order_id where t.reference = '$1'"
